Why aren't we doing the standard discovery commands like 
- get version ,
- get capabilities,
- negotiate algorithms 

before we do a get digest ?

We are doing VCA negotiation before getDigest. initializeSpdmConnection will call libspdm_init_connection. libspdm_init_connection is a wrapper in DMTF libspdm library which does version, capabilities and alogorithms.
This seems to check if the VCA was successful . But wouldn't we need to do extra checking for the version number ? and disable certain commands that are not part of a specified version ?
